cases.title: Multi-typology mule — one account, five composed signals
cases.summary: Synthetic Canadian retail account A-00038593 (customer P-0010361) fired five non-redundant detectors that each ground to a distinct US-federal advisory indicator. The triple-null pattern: one mule runs every typology, so the signals co-occur on a single subject.
